For the love of food

Partners in protein and providers of ingenious new products that consumers love.

Who we are

A flavour of what we do

Infused with ingenuity

Developing and translating trends into new markets to grow our customers' businesses. We set the bar in delivering delicious new food experiences that consumers love and buy every day.

Market insight

Power of partnership

Partnership is at the root of our success – both with our customers and our people.

A quick overview
Experts with taste

We're partners for growth

We have multi-category expertise with a focus on quality and innovation. We deliver what customers need and consumers want.

Our expertise

Meat

Our business began with meat, and we've developed market-leading expertise globally. Customers trust the quality we bring. We’re always investing in new technology to deliver more value, efficiency and consumer-led innovative solutions.

More about our meat expertise

Seafood

Seafood procurement is complex. We make it sustainable. We’re well known for our commitment to ESG, but also for delivering what consumers want: a healthy, natural product that tastes great and is easy to prepare and cook.

More about our seafood expertise

Vegan & Vegetarian

We’ve been leading the field in delicious, innovative meat alternatives for over 40 years. Today, vegan and vegetarian food is an essential part of everyday eating, and we operate dedicated meat-free facilities to develop insight-driven products that consumers desire.

More about our meat alternative expertise

Easier Meals

Convenience is king in this category. But so is quality and affordability. Thanks to our cutting-edge processing technology, we help our customers find a way to deliver on all fronts across slow cooked, raw ready to cook, ready meals and ready to eat products.

More about our meal solutions expertise

Supply Chain Services

Our dedicated Foods Connected platform gives a 360º degree perspective over supply chains. And we channel our time-honoured expertise and bespoke automation solutions to help customers unlock new efficiencies that add value and make business easier.

More about our services

Global scale. Local specialism.

Where you’ll find us

We’re a global business, based on understanding local cultures, tastes and consumer needs. With our scale, we’re able to collaborate and share our expertise and learnings across markets and tailor product propositions to new ones.

Growth through partnership

Come and join the Hilton Foods family

Our business is based on people. Partnering to develop and deliver amazing new products. If you’re passionate about food and partnership, there could be a career for you here, whatever your skillset.

Explore careers

Delivering long term growth

Our business is built on a foundation of exceptional growth and proven capability to deliver growth through partnership. We do this through; Outstanding Protein Products; New, Global Markets; Industry-Leading Automation, Engineering and Supply Chain Services; all delivered through The Sustainable Protein Plan.

For more information visit out investors section
Responsibility

We take our responsibilities seriously

We have strong commitments to our products, our people and our planet. So it’s our mission to make nutritious protein more sustainable. And to create value for customers in a way that supports people, ethics, equity and science-led environmental impacts.

Find out more about our responsibility

Our responsible approach

The responsibility to create and maintain a food system that's sustainable for the future is at the heart of our business. It demands that we protect and restore our planet's resources, enhance the lives of people and animals, and create balanced and healthy products.

Read more about our 2025 Sustainable Protein Plan
